title: Open WCOMMAND Screen and Check Input/Output Command Word Values for Left/Right Tipper
summary: On the Tipper HMI / WebVisu (VISU_MANCONTROL), open the WCOMMAND sub-screen to view the WCS input/output Command Word values for the selected tipper, and use NEXT SIDE to switch between left and right tipper communication.
when_to_use: Use when you need to verify the WCS communication as shown on the operator station tipper HMI by checking the input/output Command Word values for the left vs right tipper on the WCOMMAND screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Navigate the VISU_MANCONTROL screen, open the WCOMMAND sub-screen, and verify that input/output Command Word values are displayed and change appropriately when switching left/right with NEXT SIDE.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the Operator Station maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL and its WCOMMAND sub-screen.

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the WCOMMAND button (Item 10) and NEXT SIDE navigation context.
wCommand (WCOMMAND) screen showing the input/output Command Word values and navigation elements.

steps.title: Open VISU_MANCONTROL (Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen)
steps.purpose: Get to the maintenance manual control screen that contains the WCOMMAND navigation button.
steps.instruction: On the Tipper HMI / WebVisu (VISU), open the Operator Station maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed with the WCOMMAND button available (Item 10).
steps.healthy_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL is visible and the WCOMMAND button is present for navigation to the WCOMMAND sub-screen.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL does not open, or the WCOMMAND button is not available.

actions.label: Open VISU_MANCONTROL
actions.exact_action: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen; Item 10 is the WCOMMAND button to open a screen with input/output Command Word values for the respective tipper to WCS.

steps.title: Press WCOMMAND button to open WCOMMAND sub-screen
steps.purpose: Open the screen that displays the WCS input/output Command Word values for the respective tipper.
steps.instruction: On VISU_MANCONTROL, press the WCOMMAND button (Item 10).
steps.expected_result: The WCOMMAND sub-screen opens and displays input and output Command Word values for the respective tipper to WCS.
steps.healthy_condition: The WCOMMAND screen is open and shows both input and output Command Word values (not missing/blank).
steps.failure_condition: The WCOMMAND screen does not open, or the Command Word input/output values are missing/blank.

actions.label: Open WCOMMAND sub-screen
actions.exact_action: Press the WCOMMAND button (Item 10) to open a screen with the input and output Command Word values for the respective tipper to WCS.

stop_or_escalate_if: Command Word input/output values are missing/blank.

steps.title: Confirm input/output Command Word values are displayed on WCOMMAND screen
steps.purpose: Verify the WCOMMAND screen is functioning and the required values are visible for the selected tipper.
steps.instruction: On the WCOMMAND screen, confirm that the input and output Command Word values are displayed.
steps.expected_result: Input and output Command Word values are visible on the WCOMMAND screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Both input and output Command Word values are present (not blank/missing).
steps.failure_condition: Input and/or output Command Word values are missing or blank.

actions.label: Verify Command Word values
actions.exact_action: On the WCOMMAND screen, confirm that input and output Command Word values are displayed.

stop_or_escalate_if: Command Word input/output values are missing/blank.

steps.title: Use NEXT SIDE to switch between left and right tipper views and verify communication changes
steps.purpose: Confirm that the WCOMMAND screen updates to show current WCS-to-operator-station communication for the left vs right tipper.
steps.instruction: Press the NEXT SIDE button to navigate between the left and right tipper views, and confirm the displayed communication changes accordingly.
steps.expected_result: When NEXT SIDE is pressed, the displayed communication between the WCS and the operator station updates for the other tipper (left vs right).
steps.healthy_condition: The WCOMMAND screen view changes between left and right tipper communication (i.e., the displayed values/communication context updates).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing NEXT SIDE does not change the displayed communication/view, or the communication does not update when switching sides.

actions.label: Switch tipper side
actions.exact_action: To navigate between the left and right tipper, press the NEXT SIDE button.

stop_or_escalate_if: Displayed communication does not change accordingly when switching left/right.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To navigate between the left and right tipper, press the NEXT SIDE button. This displays the current communication between the WCS and the operator station.
A NEXT SIDE button allows navigation between the left and right tipper views and displays current communication between WCS and operator station.

success_criteria: Input and output Command Word values are displayed on the WCOMMAND screen.
Pressing NEXT SIDE switches the view between left and right tipper communication and the displayed communication updates accordingly.
healthy_conditions: WCOMMAND screen shows input and output Command Word values (not blank/missing).
NEXT SIDE changes the displayed communication between WCS and the operator station for left vs right tipper.
failure_conditions: Command Word input/output values are missing/blank.
NEXT SIDE does not change the displayed communication/view between left and right.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the WCOMMAND screen fails to open or if Command Word input/output values are missing/blank.
